'''Roland Durand''' was a [[Devaronian]] [[Gender|male]] criminal and the son of the [[Crime lord|crime boss]] [[Isa Durand]]. Durand was a former client of the [[information broker]] [[Ciddarin Scaleback]], whom he paid to [[Theft of Ruby|deliver]] the lizard [[Ruby (lizard)|Ruby]] to him.<ref name="Infested" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|This parlor and Ord Mantell are now my territory. But if you're looking for work, I might have use for you.|Roland Durand, to the Bad Batch|<ref name="Infested" />}}
Roland Durand attempted to work with the [[Pyke Syndicate]] and forcefully took over [[Cid's Parlor]] on [[Ord Mantell]] due to the [[planet]]'s connection to multiple [[hyperspace route]]s useful to the Pyke Syndicate. Scaleback and her employees, the [[Cloning|clone]] [[mercenary]] unit known as the [[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]] attempted a heist to steal the [[spice]] that Durand was set to sell to the [[Pyke]]s, in order to disrupt his deal and remove him from power. Durand learned that the spice had been stolen, he and his men tried to reobtain the spice, a battle ensued causing the spice to be lost. Later he informed the Pykes, who forced Scaleback and the Bad Batch to retrieve the lost spice.<ref name="Infested" />

Durand was held by the Pykes, as well as one member of the Bad Batch, [[Omega]], who was used as their hostage until the Bad Batch retrieved the spice. While being held, Durand told Omega that Ruby did not like many people when his pet snuggled up to her. After the spice was returned safely, Omega and Scaleback convinced the Pykes to allow Durand to live since they were told by the [[Trandoshan]] that if Durand died, the Pyke Syndicate would ignite a war with his mother [[Crime lord|crime boss]] [[Isa Durand]] and knew how dangerous that would be since they just came out of hiding, but they cut off one of his horns as punishment. Durand departed, leaving the parlor back in Cid's hands.<ref name="Infested" />

Later, Bad Batchers [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] made a deal with Durand and his mother. In exchange for the Pyke who cut off his horn, Roland gave the clones information on [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] scientist [[Royce Hemlock|Doctor Hemlock's]] [[Tantiss Base|base of operations]] so they could rescue [[Omega]], whom Hemlock had captured, wishing them luck in their mission.<ref name="Paths Unknown" />

==Personality and traits==
Roland Durand was a Devaronian male with green skin and brown eyes.<ref name="Infested" /> He stood at 1.86 meters tall.<ref name="Databank" /> Following a confrontation with the Bad Batch and the Pyke Syndicate, Roland lost his right horn.<ref name="Infested" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roland Durand appeared in "[[Infested]],"<ref name="Infested" /> the thirteenth episode of the first season of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'', released on [[Disney+]] on [[July 23]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-july-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in July 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> He was voiced by [[Tom Taylorson]].<ref name="Infested" />
